summary: TypeScript SDK requires bundled workflows (pre-bundled or runtime-bundled), creating awkward and heavyweight dependencies. Users request the ability to run workflows without a bundling step, a feature supported by all other Temporal SDKs.
userImpact: TypeScript developers must use an awkward and heavyweight bundling process to run workflows, unlike developers using other Temporal SDKs.
rootCause: TypeScript SDK's V8 isolate architecture requires workflow bundling for execution, though the issue questions whether this is actually a necessary requirement.
proposedFix: Remove the mandatory bundling requirement and allow workflows to run without a bundling step.
workaround: Use the current bundling approach (pre-bundle workflows or allow Temporal to bundle at runtime).
keyQuote: This is supported by every Temporal SDK except TypeScript.
